headline: Meta unveils Muse AI image generator for free
summary: Meta's new AI image generator, Muse, is now available for free through the Meta AI app, Instagram Stories, and WhatsApp.
details: Meta has unveiled its new AI image generator, Muse Image, produced by Meta Superintelligence Labs. The new feature, which was internally code-named Mango, will be available for free through the Meta AI app, as well as in Instagram Stories and WhatsApp.
Muse allows users to create custom images, with features like 'presets' to spark ideas, and prompt-based image editing. The model also features customizable filters for Instagram Stories.

The use of the new AI model is free for 'everyday creation' although, past a certain limit, users will need to use Meta's subscription plans. Meta says that Muse Video, an AI video generator, is 'already in development'.
caption:
Can AI generate your next image? Meta's new Muse tool is now free!

Meta has unveiled its new AI image generator, Muse Image, produced by Meta Superintelligence Labs. The new feature, which was internally code-named Mango, will be available for free through the Meta AI app, as well as in Instagram Stories and WhatsApp.

Muse allows users to create custom images, with features like 'presets' to spark ideas, and prompt-based image editing. The model also features customizable filters for Instagram Stories.

The use of the new AI model is free for 'everyday creation' although, past a certain limit, users will need to use Meta's subscription plans. Meta says that Muse Video, an AI video generator, is 'already in development'.
